'''Mak Eskha'rey''' was a male [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] who fought for the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] in their [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|struggle]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He was an expert [[Rebel Marksman/Legends|marksman]] with his illegally-modified [[Longblaster/Legends|longblaster]].<ref name="SWIA" />
